news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.36 (vs ₹0.11 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.36 (up from ₹0.11 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹261.9m (down 11% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹17.9m (up ₹23.2m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 6.8% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 88% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 3% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.05 loss per share (vs ₹0.09 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.05 loss per share (improved from ₹0.09 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹45.1m (down 24% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹2.51m (loss narrowed 44% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 76% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 4% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
